[TABRISI:7:22-25/r15] TABRISI, d. 548 · author | holds | People live and die on earth and will be raised from it at the resurrection.

[BURSEVI:v3p111#4/r9] BURSEVI, d. 1127 · author | holds | Divine decree governs everyone, whether prophet or saint.
[BURSEVI:v3p112/r1] BURSEVI, d. 1127 · author | holds | In the inward reading, living there means love, sincere seeking, patient endurance, and steadfast servitude while awaiting relief.

[BURSEVI:v3p112/r4] BURSEVI, d. 1127 · author | holds | The Persian verses urge striving for love and say that night prayer and dawn weeping guided the speaker through darkness.

[IBNASHUR-FULL:v8p69#3/r5] IBNASHUR-FULL, d. 1393 · أبو السعود | rejects | Abu al-Su'ud also suggests omitted intervening speech, comparing 15:56–57 and 17:61–62; Ibn Ashur rejects this because reported speech need not be exhaustive or continuous. | mentions 15:56, 15:57, 17:61, 17:62
